user.title: Add a baby
user.description: Each baby you add gets its own device, sensors, buttons and sleep calendar.

data_description.name: The baby's name, used for the device and entity names.
data_description.birth_date: Optional. Used to show the baby's age on the growth chart and milestones.

data_description.name: The baby's name, used for the device and entity names.
data_description.birth_date: Optional. Used to show the baby's age on the growth chart and milestones.

error.name_taken: Another baby already has this name.

entry_not_found.message: No baby with config entry ID {entry_id} was found.

event_not_found.message: No logged entry with ID {event_id} was found.

nothing_to_undo.message: There is nothing to undo (the undo window is 30 seconds).

already_sleeping.message: The baby is already marked as sleeping.

not_sleeping.message: The baby is not marked as sleeping.

end_before_start.message: The end time must be after the start time.

all_day_sleep.message: Sleeps need a start and end time, not whole days.

night_window_empty.message: The night can't start and end at the same time.

growth_empty.message: Enter a weight, a length or both.

weight_out_of_range.message: The weight must be between {min} and {max} kg.

length_out_of_range.message: The length must be between {min} and {max} cm.

milestone_not_custom.message: Only milestones you added can be deleted ({milestone}).

milestone_name_empty.message: Please enter a name for the milestone.

date_in_future.message: The date can't be in the future.

time_in_future.message: The time can't be in the future.

date_before_birth.message: The date can't be before the birth date ({birth_date}).

care_text_required.message: Write what was given or noted.

temperature_out_of_range.message: The temperature must be between {min} and {max} °C.

care_type_exists.message: There is already a type called {type}.

treatment_not_found.message: No treatment with ID {treatment} was found.

every_hours_out_of_range.message: The time between doses must be between {min} and {max} hours.

days_out_of_range.message: A treatment can last from 1 to {max} days.

time.name: Time
time.description: When it happened. Defaults to now.

log_feeding.name: Log feeding
log_feeding.description: Logs a feeding. Entries within the same feeding window as the previous one are added to that feeding as a side switch.

side.name: Side
side.description: Left or right breast, or bottle.

amount_ml.name: Amount
amount_ml.description: How much was fed (for bottle feeds).

time.name: Time
time.description: When it happened. Defaults to now.

time.name: Time
time.description: When the baby fell asleep. Defaults to now.

end_sleep.name: End sleep
end_sleep.description: Marks the baby as awake and stores the sleep in the sleep calendar.

time.name: Time
time.description: When the baby woke up. Defaults to now.

add_sleep.name: Add sleep
add_sleep.description: Adds a finished sleep after the fact.

undo.name: Undo last action
undo.description: Reverts the latest logged action, within 30 seconds.

delete_event.name: Delete entry
delete_event.description: Deletes a logged diaper, feeding or sleep.

config_entry_id.name: Baby
config_entry_id.description: The baby the entry belongs to.

event_id.name: Entry ID
event_id.description: The ID of the logged entry (shown in the dashboard card).

log_growth.name: Log growth
log_growth.description: Logs a weight and/or length measurement.

length.name: Length
length.description: Length or height in cm (metric) or inches (imperial).

units.name: Units
units.description: Units of the weight and length. Stored as metric.

date.name: Date
date.description: When it was measured. Defaults to today.

config_entry_id.name: Baby
config_entry_id.description: The baby the measurement belongs to.

set_milestone.name: Reach milestone
set_milestone.description: Marks a milestone as reached, or changes the date it was reached.

milestone.name: Milestone
milestone.description: The milestone key, e.g. first_steps, or the ID of a milestone you added.

date.name: Date
date.description: When it was reached. Defaults to today.

note.name: Note
note.description: Optional note. Leave it out to keep the current note.

clear_milestone.name: Clear milestone
clear_milestone.description: Marks a milestone as not reached.

add_milestone.name: Add milestone
add_milestone.description: Adds a milestone of your own, reached on the given date if one is set.

name.name: Name
name.description: What the baby did, e.g. First swim.

date.name: Date
date.description: When it was reached. Leave empty to add it as not reached yet.

milestone.name: Milestone
milestone.description: The ID of the milestone you added.

log_entry.name: Log entry
log_entry.description: Logs medicine, a temperature, a note or an entry of a type of your own.

type.name: Type
type.description: Medicine, temperature, note, or the name or ID of a type you added.

text.name: Text
text.description: What was given or noted, e.g. Paracetamol 120 mg. Needed for medicine and notes.

value.name: Value
value.description: The temperature, or a number in the unit of your own type (e.g. ml).

time.name: Time
time.description: When it happened. Defaults to now.

add_care_type.name: Add entry type
add_care_type.description: Adds a type of entry of your own, e.g. Bath, or Pumping in ml.

name.name: Name
name.description: The name of the type, e.g. Bath.

unit.name: Unit
unit.description: Optional unit for a number logged with each entry, e.g. ml. Entries with a number are charted as a line.

delete_care_type.name: Delete entry type
delete_care_type.description: Removes a type you added from the choices. Entries already logged are kept.

care_type.name: Type
care_type.description: The name or ID of the type.

add_treatment.name: Add treatment
add_treatment.description: Starts a treatment: a medicine given every few hours, for some days or until stopped.

every_hours.name: Every
every_hours.description: Hours between doses. Leave empty for a medicine given as needed.

days.name: Days
days.description: How many days. Leave empty to give it until stopped.

start.name: Start
start.description: When the treatment starts. Defaults to now.

give_dose.name: Give dose
give_dose.description: Logs a dose of a treatment.

time.name: Time
time.description: When it was given. Defaults to now.

update_treatment.name: Change treatment
update_treatment.description: Changes a treatment. Fields left out stay as they are. Doses already given keep their text.

dose.name: Dose
dose.description: e.g. 120 mg. Empty removes the dose.

every_hours.name: Every
every_hours.description: Hours between doses. 0 for a medicine given as needed.

days.name: Days
days.description: How many days from the start. 0 to give it until stopped.

start.name: Start
start.description: When the treatment starts. Without days, a new start keeps the treatment's length.
